loginHint: This is a demo. Any username and password signs you in.
resetDescription: Puts every host, setting and plugin back to how the demo started, and shows the setup again. Everything you changed is lost.
resetConfirmDescription: Everything you changed is lost and you will be signed out.
aboutDescription: Everything runs in your browser against made-up data. Terminals, files, containers and desktops are simulated, so nothing reaches a real server.
